metadata.description: Open-source orthopaedic clinical reasoning skills for AI agents — diagnosis, AO/OTA classification, treatment mapping, implant selection, outcomes, and aftercare across the orthopaedic surgical workflow. Educational reference only; not medical advice.

plugins.name: orthoskills
plugins.description: All 12 Ortho-Skills bundled into one plugin: case intake → image quality check → anatomy routing → AO/OTA classification → region-specific classifications (Garden, Pauwels, Schatzker, Neer, Mason, etc.) → differential reasoning → treatment mapping → implant selection → evidence retrieval → outcome measurement → aftercare & rehab → case report publishing. Canonical deep reference for proximal femur (AO/OTA 31); stubs for other regions ready for community expansion. Educational reference only; not medical advice; surgeon decision required.
